messages:
Alex Gomez: Quick heads-up — we're planning a staged sunset for the v1 inference API (embeddings + chat) starting 2027-05-15. Need a docs playbook + tiny pinpoint snippets for migrating small customers.
Meera Singh: Thanks. Do we have an agreed customer notice cadence? (email + console banner?)
Alex Gomez: Comms wants 3 waves: 30d, 14d, 3d. Console banner + in-app notice for hosted only; Dedicated/Private get account rep outreach.
Jin Park: On the SDK side, current v1 example uses `client.generate()` — we'll need a minimal `client.responses.create()` pinpoint snippet showing args mapping. I'll draft.
Tara O'Neill: Can someone list the top 3 breaking params so I can update the migration guide bullets?
Meera Singh: Param-wise: 1) `model` aliases changed (legacy -> new alias map), 2) `max_tokens` behavior slightly different (now enforced server-side), 3) embedding dimension rename in the response.
Jin Park: Draft snippet idea (one-liner for quick copy):
```
# v1 -> v2 minimal embed migration
# v1: resp = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-legacy", input="text")
# v2: resp = client.responses.create(model="redwood-embed-2", input=["text"], modalities=["embeddings"]) 
``` 
Alex Gomez: Love the snippet. Make sure we include fallback guidance: if redwood-embed-2 is unavailable, route to `redwood-embed-lite` with dim reduce note.
Tara O'Neill: For the docs checklist: create PR with 1) redirect maps for /v1 endpoints, 2) migration snippets (js/py/curl), 3) changelog entry, 4) 'What breaks' FAQ, 5) quick rollback tips for Dedicated customers.
Meera Singh: I'll coordinate the release note wording with Legal — single sentence that explains preservation of data + required client update.
CommsBot: Reminder: Please add `docs/sunset/` label to PRs so the release train picks them up.
Jin Park: I'll open the SDK PR today and add the pinpoint snippet to README and quickstart. Assigning @Tara for docs review.
Tara O'Neill: +1. Also we should add a tiny smoke-test snippet that verifies embedding dims so CS can triage: `assert len(resp.embeddings[0]) == expected_dim`.
Alex Gomez: Can we also put a short migration checklist in the console banner link (one page only)? 2-3 bullets + link to full guide.
Meera Singh: Yes. I'll draft the banner copy after Legal signs off.
Tara O'Neill: Who's writing the embed fallback section? I can take it if Jin is busy.
Jin Park: Please take it, thanks. I'll focus on code examples and tests.
Alex Gomez: Great. Action items: Jin = SDK PR + snippets, Tara = migration guide + fallback doc, Meera = comms copy + label, Alex = coordinate Dedicated handoffs. Ping here with PR links when ready :thumbsup:
Meera Singh: copied. tagging here for visibility @eng @devex
